create_multicriterion: create a MultiCriterion module with a dict of named losses, input keys, and weighting factors
build_weighted_loss: build a weighted multi-loss criterion that combines multiple loss functions with configurable weights
run_multicriterion_forward: run the forward pass of MultiCriterion with an input dict to compute weighted total loss
review_multicriterion_skip_zeros: review the MultiCriterion class and its skip_zeros option to skip zero-weighted loss computation
refactor_multicriterion_input_validation: refactor the MultiCriterion forward method to validate that all required input keys are present
